mapper.select: SELECT c.id AS configId, c.api_code AS apiCode, c.bus_type AS busType, c.db_name AS dbName, c.db_fields AS dbFields, c.db_col_fields_map AS dbColFieldsMap, t.id AS taskId, t.file_type AS fileType, t.file_name AS fileName, t.file_path AS filePath, t.start_date AS startDate FROM b_file_bi_config c INNER JOIN b_transfer_file_task t ON c.api_code = t.api_code and c.file_type = t.file_type LEFT JOIN b_nfsfile_bi_record r ON r.task_id = t.id WHERE t.start_date = #{dataDate} AND t.status >= 2 AND r.task_id IS NULL AND c.priority = #{priorityStatus} ORDER BY t.create_time ASC LIMIT 1;
